mods.name: Audio Engine
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Engine audio subsystem: IAudioService implementation (Music/SFX/Ambient buses), the auto-advancing music player and the audio factories (music, sounds, playlists). Replaces the former Core/Audio autoloads — the AudioModInitializer adds nodes named AudioService and MusicPlayer to the scene tree root on the boot Scenes phase, so /root/AudioService keeps resolving.

mods.name: CardBattle
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Card battle implementation on top of turn_battle_base: an action-card hand with attack/defence values, character cards, battle HUD, log and banners, end-turn flow and its own battle sounds.

mods.name: Characters Engine
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Engine characters subsystem: the character and action-card factories (entity kinds 'character' and 'action'), the avatar factory and the character panel UI. Replaces the former Core/Characters factories and Core/UI/CharacterPanel — the CharactersModInitializer publishes kernel contracts (ICharacterTemplateProvider, IActionTemplateProvider, IAvatarProvider) so core code resolves templates without referencing this assembly.

mods.name: Cooking
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Autonomous cooking mechanic: the kitchen workbench overlay in home_kitchen with recipe-based cooking (e.g. wolf meat into rations), a ration statistics panel and the home_kitchen_cooking scenario.

mods.name: Cthangover: Murakami

mods.name: Cthangover: Starter Party
mods.author: ct

mods.name: Dialog Engine

mods.description: Localization key map for developers and AI agents: every key declared in locale/*.properties or referenced by scenarios, C#, JSON, scenes, collections and manifests, per language. Activated by the --locale-atlas user arg; writes report.md/report.json and prints [TEST_RESULT].

mods.name: World Map Engine
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Engine world map subsystem: the full-screen map overlay (MapWidget), polygon zones layer, markers, the zone list + runtime override singleton, the scenario-facing map service facade with the open/close/show/hide scenario actions, and the shared zone style and enterability rules. mods.name: Quests Engine
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Engine quests subsystem: the quest factory and runtime state (QuestFactory, QuestBase/QuestData), the IQuestService implementation, quest scenario actions, quest scene conditions with the QuestParser leaf parser and the quest journal UI. Replaces the former Core/Quests state, Core/Actions quest services and actions, Core/Scenes quest conditions and Core/UI/Quests - QuestsModInitializer publishes the kernel contract (IQuestService via QuestServiceRegistry), registers the quest leaf parser and the new-game resettable; QuestsSaveable persists quest state through the generic mod save slot.

mods.name: Resource Atlas

mods.description: Cross-mod resource map for developers and AI agents: which mod requests resources (sounds, textures, scenes, entities, actions, locale keys, res:// files) provided by another mod, which mod overrides or patches another mod's resources, and whether each link is backed by manifest depends. Activated by the --resource-atlas user arg; writes report.md/report.json and prints [TEST_RESULT].

mods.name: RPG World
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Top-down tile world in the spirit of RPG Maker on top of the 2D engine mods: maps of square tiles in three layers (back, main, front) with a collision layer, walking on the grid with WASD or the arrows, events that talk, teleport or start battles with the action key E/F or on touch, random encounters. A map is a logical scene, so entry scenarios, ambience, saving and the dialog box work on maps unchanged; battles run on the turn-based platform with the game's battle core and return to the same cell. Scenario actions: rpg.battle, rpg.teleport.

locale.name: RPG World
locale.description: Top-down tile world in the spirit of RPG Maker: three tile layers and a collision layer, grid walking with WASD, events on the action key E/F, random encounters and battles that return to the map.

locale.name: RPG-мир
locale.description: Мир из тайлов с видом сверху в духе RPG Maker: три слоя тайлов и слой коллизий, ходьба по клеткам на WASD, события по клавише действия E/F, случайные встречи и бои с возвратом на карту.

mods.name: RPG Demo
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Content of the RPG demo (collection rpg_demo): a village, the elder's house and a forest with a wolf at the cave, made of rpg_map files over the village_pack tileset. Shows teleports, talking NPCs, events that change with story flags, chests, things to gather in the forest (brushwood, stones, mushrooms that heal), a merchant who sells elixirs and buys the junk, a map monster with a win flag and random encounters in the forest. Only data and scenarios, no C#.

mods.name: RPG Map Editor
mods.author: ct
mods.description: Editor of the rpg mod's tile maps (maps/*.json): paints the back, main and front tile layers and the collision layer with a pencil, an eraser and a flood fill from the tileset palette, places and edits map events (look, trigger, scenario, inline commands, teleport, condition), sets the map size, spawn and random encounters. Undo/redo, live update of the running world after saving, play from the spawn. Opens from the main menu tools, the novel editor hub and the in-game toolbar.

mods.name: Scenario Studio
mods.author: ct
mods.description: In-game scenario debugger and live editor: a non-modal dock over the running game with pause, step, breakpoints and restarts (with state rollback), the current scenario line, scene candidates with the reason they did or did not start, editable game state, an event log and the scene map. Edits go into folder mods or into a per-game studio layer over read-only mods, which can be exported as a mod; backgrounds dropped into a mod or the layer during the game are picked up with the "Resources" button of the transport bar. Author mode shows the script, novice mode the story moment.

locale.name: Студия сценариев
